description: Source code implementing RSA padding functions for OpenSSL, including PKCS1 and PSS padding schemes, with cryptographic operations and error handling.

methods.name: RSA_padding_add_PKCS1_type_1
methods.description: Adds PKCS#1 v1.5 padding type 1 to a message for RSA signature.

methods.name: RSA_padding_check_PKCS1_type_1
methods.description: Checks and removes PKCS#1 v1.5 padding type 1 from a message.

methods.name: RSA_padding_add_none
methods.description: Adds no padding, just copies data if sizes match.

methods.name: PKCS1_MGF1
methods.description: Mask Generation Function 1 used in PSS padding.

methods.name: RSA_verify_PKCS1_PSS_mgf1
methods.description: Verifies RSA PSS signature with MGF1.

methods.name: RSA_padding_add_PKCS1_PSS_mgf1
methods.description: Creates RSA PSS padding with MGF1.
